# LumaNote v0.1.3
Release date: 2026-06-16
## 更新详情
- 新增显示模式设置：可以选择跟随系统、亮色或暗色，从亮色/暗色切回跟随系统时会立即刷新。 - 新增首次启动引导：引导设置快捷呼出/隐藏、自动更新、开机自启、工作区、文件切换和左右滑切换文档。 - 优化剪切板库：滚动更轻，提取结果继续跟随原始剪切板记录显示，提取顺序更符合文本本身。 - 优化顶部胶囊、Markdown 滚动和文档滑动预览的性能，同时保留剪切板识别时的流动高光。 - 优化左右滑切换 Markdown 文档：同一工作区内切换更顺，切换后顶部胶囊会主动显示当前文件名。 - 调整新用户默认外观：便签透明度 60%，玻璃质感 20%。
## Update Details
- Added appearance mode settings: follow system, light, and dark. Switching back to system mode now refreshes immediately. - Added first-launch onboarding for shortcuts, automatic update checks, launch at login, workspaces, file switching, and left-right document swipe. - Improved clipboard library scrolling while keeping extracted values attached to their original clipboard records. - Reduced overhead around the top island, Markdown scrolling, and document swipe previews while keeping the flowing highlight animation. - Improved left-right Markdown document switching inside the active workspace; after switching, the top capsule reveals the current filename. - Updated new-user defaults to 60% note opacity and 20% glass texture strength.
## 安装提示
This build is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple notarized. macOS may show an "unidentified developer" warning on first launch. Download only from the official release page and verify the SHA256 checksum before opening.
如果 macOS 阻止首次打开，请进入 `系统设置` -> `隐私与安全`，找到 LumaNote 的提示，点击 `仍要打开`，再确认 `打开`。
